description: A Web Forms request in which the page's single server form posts back to its own URL so the server can raise control events such as `Click`.
Control state serialized into the hidden `__VIEWSTATE` field and restored on postback, which keeps values between requests and can bloat pages.
The fixed sequence of Web Forms stages (`Init`, `Load`, control events, `PreRender`, `Render`, `Unload`) that decides when page code runs.
A WCF interface marked `[ServiceContract]` whose `[OperationContract]` methods, with `[DataContract]` types, define the SOAP operations and WSDL.
The WCF setting for transport and encoding, such as `BasicHttpBinding` for SOAP 1.1 over HTTP or `NetTcpBinding` for binary TCP.
A .NET Foundation, MIT-licensed port of the WCF server side to ASP.NET Core, with a support policy published by Microsoft.
The `System.ServiceModel.*` packages that let modern .NET call SOAP services through proxies generated by `dotnet-svcutil`.
